# Best Converter

> Free, 100% private in-browser utility tools, image converters, PDF tools, and calculators. All processing runs entirely inside client device memory (RAM) using HTML5, WebAssembly, and JavaScript APIs. Zero files or data are ever uploaded to any server.

Website: https://zixtool.online
Canonical Domain: zixtool.online
Zero-Upload Architecture: https://zixtool.online/privacy-explained/

## PDF & Document Tools

- [Merge PDF](https://zixtool.online/merge-pdf/): Combine multiple PDF documents into one file directly in browser memory with zero file size limits.
- [Split PDF](https://zixtool.online/split-pdf/): Extract specific pages or custom page ranges from any PDF document without uploading.
- [Compress PDF](https://zixtool.online/compress-pdf/): Optimize and reduce PDF document byte size locally in browser memory.
- [JPG to PDF](https://zixtool.online/jpg-to-pdf/): Combine multiple JPG/JPEG photos into a standardized PDF document with custom margins and page sizes.
- [PNG to PDF](https://zixtool.online/png-to-pdf/): Combine PNG images and screenshots into a single multi-page PDF document.
- [HEIC to PDF](https://zixtool.online/heic-to-pdf/): Convert iPhone HEIC camera photos and receipts into clean PDF documents.

- [HEIC Format Guide](https://zixtool.online/formats/heic/): Technical specifications, Apple compression architecture, and compatibility matrix.
- [WebP Format Guide](https://zixtool.online/formats/webp/): VP8 intra-frame block coding, alpha channel support, and browser adoption benchmarks.
- [AVIF Format Guide](https://zixtool.online/formats/avif/): AV1 image compression, HDR support, and next-generation web delivery.
- [PNG Format Guide](https://zixtool.online/formats/png/): Lossless Deflate compression, 8-bit/16-bit alpha channels, and raster graphics standards.
